newsitem.title: USA: Judge issues order vs Calif. broker W.S. Clearing.
newsitem.headline: Judge issues order vs Calif. broker W.S. Clearing.

text.p: A federal judge on Friday issued a temporary restraining order against California stock broker-dealer W.S. Clearing Inc and its principal, William Sedkey Saydein, the Securities and Exchange Commission said.
The restraining order, issued by Judge Robert Takasugi in Los Angeles, will prevent the firm from further violations of net capital and customer protection rules, the SEC said.

Judge Takasugi also granted the SEC's request to appoint a temporary receiver to safeguard the firm's 15,000 client accounts and client securities with a market value of about $194 million, the SEC office in Los Angeles said.
